cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(GAcidBase VERSION 1.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(JUCE GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git GIT_TAG f72bad64d29715216226685810c5196bd0d79d77 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)
# assets/G-AcidBase-Logo-512.png is generated by scripts/make_logo.py.
juce_add_plugin(GAcidBase
    COMPANY_NAME "G-Audio" BUNDLE_ID "audio.gaudio.gacidbase"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE GAcB PLUGIN_CODE GaB1
    PRODUCT_NAME "G-AcidBase" DESCRIPTION "Goa acid bass synthesizer"
    FORMATS VST3 Standalone IS_SYNTH TRUE NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE VST3_CATEGORIES Instrument Synth
    ICON_BIG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/G-AcidBase-Logo-512.png")
juce_generate_juce_header(GAcidBase)
target_sources(GAcidBase PRIVATE Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp Source/AcidEngine.cpp Source/MusicalFeatures.cpp Source/FeatureEditor.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(GAcidBase PUBLIC JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 JUCE_USE_CURL=0 JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0 JUCE_PLUGINHOST_VST3=1 GACIDBASE_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")
target_link_libraries(GAcidBase PUBLIC juce::juce_audio_utils juce::juce_dsp PRIVATE juce::juce_recommended_config_flags juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)
juce_add_console_app(GAcidBaseTests PRODUCT_NAME "G-AcidBase Tests")
juce_generate_juce_header(GAcidBaseTests)
target_sources(GAcidBaseTests PRIVATE Tests/Main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(GAcidBaseTests PRIVATE GAcidBase juce::juce_recommended_config_flags)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME GAcidBaseTests COMMAND GAcidBaseTests "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/GAcidBase_artefacts/$<CONFIG>/VST3/G-AcidBase.vst3")
set_tests_properties(GAcidBaseTests PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
juce_add_console_app(GAcidBaseFeatureTests PRODUCT_NAME "G-AcidBase Feature Tests")
juce_generate_juce_header(GAcidBaseFeatureTests)
target_sources(GAcidBaseFeatureTests PRIVATE Tests/Features.cpp)
target_link_libraries(GAcidBaseFeatureTests PRIVATE GAcidBase juce::juce_recommended_config_flags)
add_test(NAME GAcidBaseFeatureTests COMMAND GAcidBaseFeatureTests)
set_tests_properties(GAcidBaseFeatureTests PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
